say:2:1321202002:1.text: I think I hear it talking...

say:4:1321202004:1.text: Oh, I remember! That's the snowman from the ceremony!
say:4:1321202004:1.source_cn: 啊！我想起来了，这不是祭典上面的那个雪人吗！

say:5:1321202005:1.text: That mage activated so many snowmen... What was his name?
say:5:1321202005:1.source_cn: 那个魔法师激活了好多雪人……叫什么来着？

say:6:1321202006:1.text: ... Witstaff! Played around with his magic and made the snowmen go crazy and melt!
say:6:1321202006:1.source_cn: ——维茨瓦夫！乱用魔法让雪人们都狂化了！

say:7:1321202007:1.text: Luckily it was out in the middle of nowhere, where those rampaging snowmen couldn't hurt anyone at least.
say:7:1321202007:1.source_cn: 幸好这里荒郊野岭，当时那些狂暴的雪人，太容易伤人了。

say:8:1321202008:1.text: Magister, we have to dispel that awful magic from the snowman!
say:8:1321202008:1.source_cn: 主人，我们得赶紧消除它身上错误的魔法！
say:8:1321202008:1.male: Magister, we have to dispel that awful magic from the snowman!
say:8:1321202008:1.female: Magister, we have to dispel that awful magic from the snowman!

say:10:1321202009:1.text: Huh? There's a human... And two talking rats! I've been spotted!
say:10:1321202009:1.source_cn: 什么？有人类……还有两只会说话的老鼠！咱被发现了！

say:11:1321202010:1.text: Run, run! I haven't even seen the wildflowers yet. I can't get held up here!
say:11:1321202010:1.source_cn: 快跑快跑！咱还没见过花呢！可不能在这里被逮到。

cinematic_dialogue:15:1321201001:.text: How come there aren't any wildflowers here? ...
cinematic_dialogue:15:1321201001:.source_cn: 这里怎么也没有野花啊……

cinematic_dialogue:15:1321201002:.text: It's not easy being a snowman!

cinematic_dialogue:15:1321201003:.text: I have to see them—before I melt away!

narration:17:13021211:0.text: You encounter a snowman escaping from the festival in the wild but accidentally scare it away.
narration:17:13021211:0.source_cn: 你们在野外遇到一只从祭典上逃跑的雪人，却不小心把它吓跑了。

say:0:1321203001:0.text: Oh, it heard us! And it sure can run fast!
say:0:1321203001:0.source_cn: 呀！它听到我们说话了——跑得好快！

say:1:1321203002:0.text: Run, Magister! We have to chase him!
say:1:1321203002:0.male: Run, Magister! We have to chase him!
say:1:1321203002:0.female: Run, Magister! We have to chase him!

say:0:1321204001:0.text: A snowman's life is short and I just wanna see the flowers! Let me go!
say:0:1321204001:0.source_cn: 雪生短暂，想看朵花，放过咱吧！

say:0:1321205001:0.text: Whoa.. He... He really knows how to run!

say:1:1321205002:0.text: It's not easy being a snowman, and I'd prefer not to run. Just leave me be!
say:1:1321205002:0.source_cn: 雪生不易，行行好，别追咱啦——

say:1:1321208002:0.text: There's a painter there. Let's go ask him about it.

say:1:1321209001:1.text: Hi! Did you happen to see a little snowman running by?
say:1:1321209001:1.source_cn: 您好！请问您看到有个小雪人跑过去吗？

say:2:1321209002:1.text: What do you mean a running snowman? You mean these here? I made all of them myself! It took me forever too!
say:2:1321209002:1.source_cn: 什么会跑的雪人？你问前面这堆？\n——我堆的！费了我好...

say:3:1321209003:1.text: What did you make all these snowmen for?
say:3:1321209003:1.source_cn: 你在这里堆这么多雪人做什么呀？

say:4:1321209004:1.text: Well, this is a scene for my painting, of course!
say:4:1321209004:1.source_cn: 喏，这不是画画的布景嘛。

say:5:1321209005:1.text: My idol, Master Arteka, is coming to Cedartown to paint landscapes.
say:5:1321209005:1.source_cn: 我的偶像——大师阿托卡——刚好来雪松镇写生。

say:7:1321209007:1.text: You don't know? Cedartown has great fields of wildflowers. The town is famous for its stunning views. The master is coming to paint them.
say:7:1321209007:1.source_cn: 你们不知道？雪松镇有片花海，很出名的，大师就是为此慕名而来。

say:8:1321209008:1.text: And as for me, I want to paint something great so I can show it to Arteka and hopefully have a chance to speak with him.
say:8:1321209008:1.source_cn: 我呢，想好好画一张满意的作品，然后带去和偶像交流。

say:9:1321209009:1.text: And maybe he'll even give me some pointers!
say:9:1321209009:1.source_cn: 说不定……还能得到大师的指导呢！

say:10:1321209010:1.text: Why are you guys still here? I need to start painting.
say:10:1321209010:1.source_cn: 嗯？你们怎么还在这里？我要开始画画了。

say:11:1321209011:1.text: Magister, I think that little snowman must be hiding here somewhere.
say:11:1321209011:1.source_cn: 主人，我觉得那个小雪人，绝对藏在这里面。
say:11:1321209011:1.male: Magister, I think that little snowman must be hiding here somewhere.
say:11:1321209011:1.female: Magister, I think that little snowman must be hiding here somewhere.

say:12:1321209012:1.text: Don't you understand, Chippy? The painter doesn't want us here...
say:12:1321209012:1.source_cn: 哎呀！你没听出来这画家在送客吗？

choice_prompt:13:1321209012.text: Don't you understand, Chippy? The painter doesn't want us here...
choice_prompt:13:1321209012.source_cn: 哎呀！你没听出来这画家在送客吗？

say:15:1321209014:1.text: But it takes so long to make a snowman.
say:15:1321209014:1.source_cn: 可是……堆雪人很花费时间啊……

say:16:1321209017:1.text: Oh! I know... Hey Chippy, I have a sudden urge to make some snowmen! Don't you? *Wink*
say:16:1321209017:1.source_cn: 哎呀……突然有点想堆雪人了呢。

say:17:1321209018:1.text: No! What are you talking about? This is not the time to... OUCH! Why did you step on me?
say:17:1321209018:1.source_cn: 这个时候了怎么突然想堆雪人……你踩我干嘛！

say:18:1321209019:1.text: Oh... Oh! Yes! Chippy loves making snowmen!

say:19:1321209020:1.text: Oh, wow. Do you want to help me make some snowmen?
say:19:1321209020:1.source_cn: 那个，你们要不……帮我堆点雪人？

say:20:1321209021:1.text: That way I could focus on painting... And maybe I can finish quicker!
say:20:1321209021:1.source_cn: 我这样就可以专心画画了……也许能快点完成！

say:21:1321209022:1.text: Oh, Magister! You were so smart to make him think he needed more snowmen! Now's our chance to look for that weird one.
say:21:1321209022:1.source_cn: 不愧是主人！这样就可以趁机检查雪人了。
say:21:1321209022:1.male: Oh, Magister! You were so smart to make him think he needed more snowmen! Now's our chance to look for that weird one.
say:21:1321209022:1.female: Oh, Magister! You were so smart to make him think he needed more snowmen! Now's our chance to look for that weird one.

choice:13:0:1.text: It would've been better with more snowmen.
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 雪人再多点就更好看了。
choice:13:0:1.male: It would've been better with more snowmen.
choice:13:0:1.female: It would've been better with more snowmen.

say:23:1321209015:1.text: Are they melting again? I don't even have time to paint!
say:23:1321209015:1.source_cn: 又化了？我还没画几天呢！

say:24:1321209016:1.text: It took me forever to make all of these!

choice:13:1:2.text: Oh, some of the snowmen are melting!
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 哎呀~怎么有些雪人要化了。
choice:13:1:2.male: Oh, some of the snowmen are melting!
choice:13:1:2.female: Oh, some of the snowmen are melting!

say:0:1321213001:0.text: Phew, good thing I can run fast!

say:2:1321213003:0.text: I got lucky. Something tripped him up.
say:2:1321213003:0.source_cn: 幸好刚刚有什么拌了它一跤。

say:1:1321214001:0.text: No! I've been working on this painting for a whole month!
say:1:1321214001:0.source_cn: 不！这幅画我画了整整一个月！

say:4:1321214002:1.text: Oh! Our little snowman seems to have knocked over his easel.
say:4:1321214002:1.source_cn: 啊……小雪人好像刚刚撞倒了画框。

say:5:1321214003:1.text: Sorry! ... Seems like a bit of color is smudged... Can you paint something over it?
say:5:1321214003:1.source_cn: 对不起呀……好像蹭到了点色块，画点什么补救一下？

say:6:1321214004:1.text: I'll never be able to paint something nice...
say:6:1321214004:1.source_cn: 我果然画不出完美的作品……

say:7:1321214005:1.text: I'll have to start all over again...

say:9:1321214006:1.text: I can't listen to this anymore!

say:11:1321214007:1.text: Ack! What are you doing talking all of a sudden? Scared me half to death!
say:11:1321214007:1.source_cn: 噫——你怎么突然开口说话！吓死我了。

say:13:1321214008:1.text: Wh— What? Am I going crazy? Is that snowman... talking?
say:13:1321214008:1.source_cn: 这、这是什么！是我疯了吗？雪人在说话？

say:14:1321214009:1.text: You! Yes, you! You with the paintbrush!
say:14:1321214009:1.source_cn: 你！对，就是你！拿着画笔的这个！

say:15:1321214010:1.text: Don't you want to meet your painting master?
say:15:1321214010:1.source_cn: 你不是很想见这位大师吗？

say:16:1321214011:1.text: Of— Of course I do! I came out in the middle of nowhere just for this! I made snowmen for an entire week and I've been painting for a month!
say:16:1321214011:1.source_cn: 当、当然！我为此跑到荒郊野岭，堆了一周雪人，画了足足一个月！

say:17:1321214012:1.text: Well then go and meet your idol already!

say:18:1321214013:1.text: But— But... I don't have anything to show him.
say:18:1321214013:1.source_cn: 可、可是……我没有拿得出手的作品。

say:19:1321214014:1.text: I can't stand you guys! You have all the time in the world—and you waste it!
say:19:1321214014:1.source_cn: 受不了你们这些有一堆时间可以浪费的！

say:20:1321214015:1.text: You've been dragging this out for so long, but have you ever stopped to think: what if your idol leaves?
say:20:1321214015:1.source_cn: 你拖了这么久，就没想过：你偶像有可能离开吗？

say:21:1321214016:1.text: Yes— Yes, I do worry about that!

say:22:1321214017:1.text: And if you missed your chance, would you regret it?
say:22:1321214017:1.source_cn: 万一错过了，你不后悔吗？

say:23:1321214018:1.text: I would regret it for a lifetime, certainly!
say:23:1321214018:1.source_cn: 错过的话，我肯定会后悔一辈子！

say:24:1321214019:1.text: If you miss this chance to meet him, you might never get another chance again!
say:24:1321214019:1.source_cn: 一旦错过了，可能你们这辈子都不一定能再见面了！

say:26:1321214021:1.text: Then stop being so cautious about the whole thing! Get out there and meet him—now!
say:26:1321214021:1.source_cn: 那就不要这么瞻前顾后的！现在！立马出发！

say:27:1321214022:1.text: Let's say you've only got a week. You'd better make sure you finish what you want to do, and in a hurry!
say:27:1321214022:1.source_cn: 你要是只有一周的时间，肯定要把想做的赶紧做完呀！

say:28:1321214023:1.text: Look at me. If I don't get an eyeful of wildflowers, I ain't gonna see 'em again! A snowman's life is short. I was born melting!
say:28:1321214023:1.source_cn: 你看咱，如果不抓紧时间去看眼野花，雪生短暂，化了就再也...

say:29:1321214024:1.text: You guys have got too much time on your hands! Always thinking you'll have another chance, so you just dilly-dally your time away!
say:29:1321214024:1.source_cn: 你们就是时间太多！总觉得还有机会，才这么瞻前顾后！

say:30:1321214025:1.text: Well... You do have a point...

say:31:1321214026:1.text: Alright already. I'll just fix this smudge...
say:31:1321214026:1.source_cn: 唉！你别拉我，我补一下这个画痕……

say:32:1321214027:1.text: And for that, I'll need a new snowman... Wait, you'll be perfect for it!
say:32:1321214027:1.source_cn: 这个的话，补一个雪人吧……就是你了！

say:0:1321215001:0.text: Let's go! Off to meet the master!

say:1:1321216001:1.text: Oh! I remember Arteka painted here once before...
say:1:1321216001:1.source_cn: 啊！我记得大师之前一直在这里写生……

say:8:1321216007:1.text: Maybe he hasn't gone far. Let's search!
say:8:1321216007:1.source_cn: 也许还没走远，咱去看看！

say:10:1321216008:1.text: Slow down! You don't even know which way he went.
say:10:1321216008:1.source_cn: 别急！你都不知道大师往哪走了。

say:11:1321216009:1.text: If he was here a while, he must have left some traces.
say:11:1321216009:1.source_cn: 既然大师在这里逗留了那么久，肯定有扎营痕迹的。

say:13:1321216010:1.text: Right, right. Let's split up and look around.

say:0:1321217001:0.source_cn: 让咱看看有没有什么线索！

say:1:1321217002:0.text: Turns out he's the most anxious of us all...
say:1:1321217002:0.source_cn: 它反倒成了最着急的那个……

say:5:1321218004:1.text: So painting masters even make the designs on the soles of their shoes?
say:5:1321218004:1.source_cn: 原来艺术家连鞋印的纹路都会自己设计。

say:6:1321218005:1.text: Oh... Indeed, that's not a common design.
say:6:1321218005:1.source_cn: 嚯……确实不是常见的款式呢。

say:7:1321218006:1.text: Our luck is good. He must've been here not long ago.
say:7:1321218006:1.source_cn: 运气不错，应该是刚离开不久。

say:8:1321218007:1.text: Excellent... Amazing! Thank Dura above! Thank you all!
say:8:1321218007:1.source_cn: 太好了……太好了！感谢艾雅！感谢你们！

say:1:1321219001:1.text: Not even a shadow here. It seems... We were too late...
say:1:1321219001:1.source_cn: 完全没有看到人影……也许，还是晚了一步吧。

say:2:1321219002:1.text: Stop with the negativity! We haven't even gone all the way yet!
say:2:1321219002:1.source_cn: 不许说丧气话！还没走到头呢！

say:4:1321219003:1.text: Hmm, the footprints point that way.

say:5:1321219004:1.source_cn: 沿着这个方向再走走吧。

say:7:1321219005:1.text: You guys are so slow! Hurry the heck up!
say:7:1321219005:1.source_cn: 你们慢吞吞地，怎么来得及！

say:8:1321219006:1.text: Hand me the painting and I'll go up ahead!
say:8:1321219006:1.source_cn: 把画给我，我帮你们先去看看！

say:10:1321219007:1.text: My painting... That little snowman is strong for his size!
say:10:1321219007:1.source_cn: 我的画——这小雪人力气还真不小！

say:11:1321219008:1.text: Hey! I take my eyes off him for a second and he's gone!
say:11:1321219008:1.source_cn: 哎！一不留神就让它给跑了。

say:0:1321220001:0.text: He doesn't even have legs! How's he go so fast?!
say:0:1321220001:0.source_cn: 它连脚都没有，怎么好像更快了！

say:0:1321221001:0.text: This water on the path... Is it from the snowman?

say:1:1321221002:0.text: That's how he's running so fast.

say:0:1321223001:0.text: Hey, there he is! The snowman!

say:1:1321223002:0.text: Is that the master next to him?
say:1:1321223002:0.source_cn: 它身边那位就是大师吧？

say:3:1321224003:1.text: Ah, you'd better not pollute your eyes with such a stain...
say:3:1321224003:1.source_cn: 啊，这种粗制滥造的东西，还是不要污染了您的眼睛……

say:4:1321224004:1.text: It was him! He's been painting this a whole month for you!
say:4:1321224004:1.source_cn: 就是他！他为了见您画了一个月！

say:5:1321224005:1.text: Hey! You weren't supposed to tell him!

say:6:1321224006:1.text: Ah, well the composition and framing are quite good.
say:6:1321224006:1.source_cn: 唔，构思和取景挺不错的。

say:8:1321224008:1.text: Although... The colors could use some tweaking.
say:8:1321224008:1.source_cn: 不过……色彩还可以再调整一下。

say:10:1321224010:1.text: You couldn't find the right colors?

say:12:1321224012:1.text: Ah, it's only natural! Just look how these two colors blend.
say:12:1321224012:1.source_cn: 正常！你看把这俩颜色混一下。

say:13:1321224013:1.text: And the handling of these ambient colorations...
say:13:1321224013:1.source_cn: 这里的环境色这样处理……

say:14:1321224014:1.text: I see... That problem had been bothering me for a long time!
say:14:1321224014:1.source_cn: 原来如此……这个问题困扰我好久了！

say:15:1321224015:1.text: See? It's a good thing we showed up in time. Otherwise, we would have missed it!
say:15:1321224015:1.source_cn: 嘿！幸好咱出现得及时，这要再晚点就真错过了！

say:16:1321224016:1.text: This little snowman is so... spirited! And you've painted him in very well!
say:16:1321224016:1.source_cn: 这小雪人好精神！唔……把它画进去就不错！

say:17:1321224017:1.text: A brighter color was needed right there and he fit the bill just right.
say:17:1321224017:1.source_cn: 刚好，这里需要亮一点的颜色，它就很合适。

say:1:1321225002:0.source_cn: 阿托卡大师……您就是我的神！

say:2:1321225003:0.text: ... Forget it. May Dura forgive you.

say:1:1321226001:1.text: Heavens! I'm so lucky to have met Master Arteka at the last moment.
say:1:1321226001:1.source_cn: 天哪！幸好最后一刻见到了阿托卡大师。

say:2:1321226002:1.text: If I'd missed him... I'd have regretted it for a lifetime!
say:2:1321226002:1.source_cn: 如果错过……我肯定追悔终身！

say:3:1321226003:1.text: You'd better thank our little snowman, then!

say:4:1321226004:1.text: I'm lucky the snowman pushed me, or I'd still be obsessing over the details.
say:4:1321226004:1.source_cn: 还好小雪人推了我一把，不然我肯定还在纠结细节。

say:5:1321226005:1.text: I felt like it had to be perfect before I could make my move.
say:5:1321226005:1.source_cn: 觉得一定要改到自己满意，才敢出手。

say:6:1321226006:1.text: So I kept pushing it off...

say:8:1321226007:1.text: You've got me to thank! And you've gotta fix your... your little problem!
say:8:1321226007:1.source_cn: 多亏了咱吧！你该治……治治这个毛病了！

say:10:1321226008:1.text: The scientific name for that is "procrastination".

say:11:1321226009:1.text: And a man of action like our little snowman is the perfect cure for procrastination.
say:11:1321226009:1.source_cn: 小雪人这种行动派呢，专治拖延症。

say:12:1321226010:1.text: You always seem to be in a hurry.

say:14:1321226011:1.text: It's because... life is... so short! I've got to fight... for every second!
say:14:1321226011:1.source_cn: 因……为咱生命短……暂呀！要争分夺……秒！

say:15:1321226012:1.text: Why are you talking like that?
say:15:1321226012:1.source_cn: 你怎么说话断断续续的！

say:16:1321226013:1.text: Didn't you want to see the wildflowers? The scenery is great here!
say:16:1321226013:1.source_cn: 你不是念叨着想看花吗？这里景色不错吧！

say:0:1321227001:0.text: It wasn't easy for you to get to see the flowers. Anything you'd like to say?
say:0:1321227001:0.source_cn: 小雪人，好不容易看到花，不多说两句？

say:1:1321227002:0.text: Hey, why aren't you saying anything?

say:5:1321228004:1.text: He... He changed back into a normal snowman?
say:5:1321228004:1.source_cn: 它……这是变回普通的雪人了？

say:9:1321228010:1.text: I... I'd like to do a quick sketch for him.

say:10:1321228011:1.text: Consider this... A farewell and a thank-you gift.

say:11:1321228012:1.text: He will stand forever in the sea of wildflowers, never melting.
say:11:1321228012:1.source_cn: 它会一直在画里，在花海里……永远不化。

narration:13:1321228013:1.text: The painter did two sketches of the snowman.

say:15:1321228014:1.text: This one... is for you guys.

say:19:1321228016:1.text: His encouragement meant the world to me... And I'll never forget his lesson.
say:19:1321228016:1.source_cn: 它的鼓励对我很有意义……我会贯彻它的意志的。

say:21:1321228006:1.text: Really? But that was... so sudden!

say:23:1321228007:1.text: Well, it wasn't a powerful enchantment to begin with.
say:23:1321228007:1.source_cn: 毕竟不是强大复杂的术式。

say:24:1321228008:1.text: After all that running, it seems like he spent all his magical energy.
say:24:1321228008:1.source_cn: 刚刚跑了这么多趟，仅存的魔力应该都消耗干净了。

choice:3:1:2.text: Let's say goodbye to our little snowman.
choice:3:1:2.male: Let's say goodbye to our little snowman.
choice:3:1:2.female: Let's say goodbye to our little snowman.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1321206101:.text: Why are there so many snowmen?!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1321207002:.source_cn: 不会手抖的……不会手抖的！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1321207003:.text: Just one more stroke... And my painting will be done!
